title: Violence
lead: The Hebrew chamas names wrong done by force, usually by the strong to the weak, and the Bible treats it as the crime that fills the earth before judgment: the flood (Genesis 6:11), the cry of Job and of Habakkuk, and the sin of Jerusalem's leaders and of Babylon.

sections.b: Genesis 6:11-13 says the earth was full of violence. Job cries "Violence!" and gets no answer (Job 19:7). Jeremiah accuses the king of spilling innocent blood and crushing others (Jeremiah 22:17). Habakkuk opens with the cry (1:2), says the Chaldeans come "for violence" (1:9), and in the woes names the violence done to the land and the town (2:8, 17). The law limits it (Exodus 21-23) and the prophets promise its end (Isaiah 60:18).
